title: Ceres Retail LLM gateway integration scratchpad
content:
Context:
- Customer: Ceres Retail (mid-market omni-channel retailer).
- Goal: Replace brittle rules-based routing for search/autocomplete with a lightweight LLM gateway that provides product-aware suggestions, intent classification, and reranking while staying inside their VPC.
- Primary contact: Elena Morales (CTO) + lead infra engineer Tom Hwang.

Call notes (2026-03-05 discovery call):
- Ceres has a hybrid infra: public cloud (GCP) + on-prem caching layer for catalog. They require private deployment (VPC peering) for PII-sensitive enrichment columns.
- Traffic pattern: peak 2k QPS for suggestions during flash sales; baseline 350 QPS. Spiky bursts (10s-30s) are common.
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile < 80ms for short suggestions (<= 32 tokens). Product team will tolerate up to 150ms in degraded mode.
- Throughput target: need to service 1000 concurrent interactive sessions during peak.
- Security: Must integrate with Okta SSO + customer KMS for key wrapping. Audit logs required for 90 days.
- Data residency: US-only.
- Acceptance criteria: A/B test on runway for 2 weeks with no >1% drop in conversion compared to current rules engine.

Key technical requirements:
- Private control plane with VPC peering or customer-managed control plane? They asked for private control plane but also easier ops. Recommend Hosted control plane + VPC peering for runtime (Redwood Private-lite).
- Must support model pinning and canary rollouts. They will want to test distilled 7B variant first.
- KV cache for prefix reuse across identical product queries (many repeated prefixes).
- Per-route token & latency cost telemetry to map spend to business events.
- Function/tool calling: ability to call internal product-lookup service (RPC) to get inventory signals. This must happen inside their network.
- Transform/filtering hook to redact SKU-level PII before logs leave VPC.

Architecture sketch (options):
A) Fully private deployment (on-prem or VPC with private control plane): runtime nodes in Ceres VPC, control plane in Redwood-managed private region. Pros: max isolation, no outgoing data. Cons: slower onboarding, higher contract.
B) Hybrid (recommended for pilot): Redwood hosted control plane + private runtime in Ceres VPC (k8s/GKE). Use Private Connect/VPC peering, KMS integration, and log-forwarding into customer ELK. Pros: fast pilot, good isolation at runtime.

Performance tuning notes / gotchas:
- Batch sizing: because many requests are short (12–20 tokens generated), use small batch windows (10–50ms) to reduce tail latency. Aggressive batching will reduce cost but increase P95.
- KV cache expiration: product catalogs change during flash sales; set conservative TTL (60s) and invalidate on deploy or explicit webhook from Ceres product service.
- Quantization: start with fp16 for 7B distill; if memory pressure occurs, recommend 4-bit quantization but require eval on quality — retrain/finetune risk.
- Fallback policy: if runtime saturates, fall back to rules-based suggestions endpoint (they already have) to maintain availability. Add weighted A/B during ramp.
- Tokenization mismatch: Ceres product names include many SKU tokens and punctuation. Need to test tokenization to avoid hallucination in reranker.

Prompt sketches (examples to capture for eval):
- Intent classification prompt: "User: {query}
Return: one of [browse, buy, support, store-locator] with confidence score and 1-line reason."
- Suggestion prompt: include product embeddings/IDs as context window. Avoid returning SKU strings unless confidence > 0.9.

Data & compliance:
- Logs: redact any SKU patterns that match regex since customer considers some SKUs sensitive (per legal).
- KMS: customer requires CMK root; need to validate supported KMS providers + HSM path.
- Audit: retention 90d; must provide exportable audit logs streaming to customer SIEM.

Unresolved questions (to triage with tech lead / security):
1) Can the customer accept hosted control plane with private runtime? If not, explore Private deployment SLA/cost.
2) Exact QPS distribution during flash sale windows — ask for 1 hour of production traffic histogram.
3) Does their Okta setup allow service-to-service authentication for runtime nodes? Need Okta app details.
4) Which KMS provider + CMK naming conventions?
5) Are there rate-limited third-party APIs in the tool chain (product enrichment) that will add latency?

Action items / next steps:
- [Asha] Provision internal pilot estimate (cost + infra) for hybrid option and share by 2026-03-10. (ACTION: done — estimate attached in linked artifacts)
- [Marco] Spin up a small private runtime PoC in our sandbox (GKE peering simulation) to demo VPC peering handshake. Target: 2026-03-12.
- [Priya] Draft A/B test plan template for conversion comparison (2-week runway). Include sample size calc. Due: 2026-03-09.
- [Eng] Add token-redaction hook prototype that applies customer SKU regex before logs leave runtime. (JIRA: SE-3412)
- [Customer] Provide 1 week of anonymized production query traces and Okta service account details.

Pilot success metrics (proposed):
- Availability: >99.9% during pilot; fallback usage <3%.
- Latency: P95 < 120ms; P50 < 40ms for suggestions.
- Business: No more than 1% drop in click-to-conversion vs baseline rules engine over A/B cohort.
- Quality: 90th percentile of relevance score >= baseline (use offline judged eval).

Notes to self / messy thoughts:
- Might push quantization suggestions later; early-stage product team more worried about safety than penny savings.
- Consider serving a distilled reranker in front of generator to reduce hallucination on SKU suggestions.
- Check whether we can instrument per-route token breakdown without leaking prompts to hosted logs if hosted control plane used.

Quick links & artifacts for meeting:
- Pilot estimate spreadsheet: GDrive link (placeholder)
- SE-3412: token-redaction hook (Jira)
- Confluence draft integration runbook: CONFLUENCE:CRS-INTG-GATEWAY-2026
- Example prompt set + eval harness: GITHUB:repo/ceres-integration-pr#78

Meeting prep for 2026-03-12:
- Demo: small PoC showing VPC peering + sample latency numbers from our sandbox (have p95 sim).
- Bring the A/B test template and pilot SLAs.
- Confirm open security questions and list necessary artifacts for security review.

End of scratchpad.
